mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
